role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 米波可以召唤多达四个永久复制体，使自己同时在多条战线上作战。他的分身四散在战场上，一旦找到敌人，他就会将其束缚，其余分身在爆炸性的传送中集合，然后将遇难者亲手埋葬。
hero_summary_en: By summoning up to five permanent copies of himself, Meepo can fight from every front at once. Spreading his clones throughout the battlefield, when an enemy is found, he binds his foe, gathers his selves with an explosive teleport, then buries what remains.

abilities.name: meepo_earthbind
abilities.description_zh: 向目标地点扔出一张网，缠绕区域内所有敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
notes_zh: 地之束缚可以使敌方单位在进入隐身后显形，但是不能作用于已经隐身的单位。
对减益免疫单位和肉山无效。
notes_en: Does not work on Debuff Immune units or Roshan.

abilities.name: meepo_poof
abilities.description_zh: 通过从大地中汲取神秘的能量，一个米波可以在持续施法%cast_duration%秒后传送至另一个米波或自身所在之处，在离开和到达的区域都对敌人造成伤害。如果技能设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，所有米波也会对目标施放忽悠。对地施放后，除了选中的米波外所有米波会忽悠至最近的地点。
abilities.description_en: Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
notes_zh: 可以传送至米波的幻象。
notes_en: Can be cast through the minimap.

abilities.name: meepo_ransack
abilities.description_zh: 每次攻击都会窃取敌人的生命值，并治疗所有其他米波相同数值生命。对非英雄单位的效果减少至60%。
abilities.description_en: Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.Reduced to 60% against creeps.
notes_zh: 治疗数值会被生命回复增强效果提升。
notes_en: Amount healed is amplified by Health Restoration Amplification

abilities.name: meepo_petrify
abilities.description_zh: 挖掘进入地下，对自身施加驱散效果，无敌且不能作为目标，持续%duration%秒。持续时间内回复最大生命值的%hp_restore%%%。被缠绕时无法施放。驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en: Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for %duration%s. Restores %hp_restore%%% of his max health over that duration.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: meepo_megameepo
abilities.description_zh:
主米波将%radius%范围内其他米波放到自己的肩膀上。在这个形态下，他会获得其他米波%stats_pct%%%的属性，并且可以把他们扔向敌人，造成伤害和减速。

生效时地之束缚会产生额外的网，身上每只米波都会使忽悠造成额外%poof_damage_factor%%%伤害。
abilities.description_en:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a %radius% radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains %stats_pct%%% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals %poof_damage_factor%%% more damage for each Meepo on top.

abilities.name: meepo_divided_we_stand
abilities.description_zh: 米波再召唤出一个米波，可以跟随米波本体升级并共用物品。技能的冷却时间相互独立，但是物品的冷却时间在米波之间共用，回城卷轴除外。来自物品的攻击力、攻击速度、生命值、魔法值、恢复效果、法力损毁和触发几率会根据米波数量均分，在每只身上的效果减少%dps_penalty_pct%%%。任意米波阵亡都会导致所有米波全体死亡。
abilities.description_en: Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls. Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.If any Meepo dies, they all die.
facet_text_en: Can now be upgraded at level %required_level% and every %bonus_levels_between_upgrades% levels afterwards to a max level of %max_level%. Duplicate Meepos receive %main_meepo_stats_pct%%% of the main Meepo's bonus attributes.
All Meepos have a stackable aura that increases nearby Meepos' attack speed by %support_group_attack_speed_pct%%% and armor by %support_group_armor%. Radius: %support_radius%.
facet_text_zh: 现在可以在%required_level%级时学习，之后每%bonus_levels_between_upgrades%级可以再升级一次，最高为%max_level%级。米波克隆体获得米波本体%main_meepo_stats_pct%%%的额外属性。
所有米波都拥有可叠加的光环，提升附近米波%support_group_attack_speed_pct%%%攻击速度和%support_group_armor%点护甲。作用范围：%support_radius%。

abilities.name: meepo_geomancy
abilities.description_zh: 米波会根据所在地形给予自身和克隆体可叠加的加成效果。每个米波都会给予其他米波自身的加成。如果%tree_radius%范围内有树木，他会获得%tree_regen%点/秒生命恢复。如果他站在土地上，他会获得%dirt_move_speed%%%移动速度加成。如果他在水中，他的攻击会减缓目标%water_move_slow%%%移速，持续%water_slow_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain.  Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.If there is a tree within %tree_radius% range, he receives %tree_regen% HP regen.If he is standing on dirt, he receives %dirt_move_speed%%% bonus movement speed.If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by %water_move_slow%%% for %water_slow_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 土地包括所有水之外的地形。
notes_en: Dirt includes any terrain that is not water.

abilities.name: meepo_megameepo_fling
abilities.description_zh: 在超大米波形态下，米波将最上端的米波向%AbilityCastRange%范围内目标扔出，造成伤害和减速。
abilities.description_en: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a %AbilityCastRange% range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_meepo_4
talents_raw.name_loc: Earthbind grants True Strike on Targets
